title: QuantiFarm DATS information
description: Generic information of a DATS being applied in a QuantiFarm testcase

datsName.description: The unique name of the DATS in the QuantiFarm testcase

datsInitialInvestmentCosts.description: The initial costs for purchasing the DATS in Euros

datsAnnualFees.description: The annual fees to remain using the DATS in Euros per year

datsMaintenanceCosts.description: The costs for maintaining the DATS in Euros per year

datsExpectedLifespan.description: The expected life span for using the DATS in whole years

datsInstallationTime.description: The expected time needed to install the DATS in days

datsTrainingTime.description: The expected time needed to train the users of the DATS in hours

datsTrainers.description: The number of people involved in the training of users of the DATS

datsTrainingCosts.description: The costs for training the users of the DATS in Euros
